Usage: aeat app ledger import [OPTIONS]

  Import bank statements or bookkeeping files into your records

Options:
  --file <path>                   Path to the bank statement file or directory
                                  [required]
  --provider <auto|csv|ofx|qfx|xlsx|xls|pdf-n26>
                                  Statement format provider.  [required]
  --dry-run                       Run the import in dry-run mode (without
                                  saving)
  --verify                        Check entries after import
  --verify-source <path>          Original file used to check imported rows.
  --verbose                       Show detailed information during import
  --period <str>                  Import only rows whose value date (or
                                  booking date) falls in this AEAT period:
                                  1T-4T (quarters), 0A (annual), 01-12
                                  (months). Requires --year.
  --year <int>                    Year of the --period filter (e.g. 2024).
  --account <str>                 Own bank account the statement belongs to
                                  (its id, e.g. acc-01). A statement that
                                  names a different account is refused.
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
